evals.name: author-command
evals.prompt: Create the AddAuthor dialog in Features/Authors/Registration. The user enters a name, not an ID.
evals.expected_output: One command owns the ID, typed field and submit action.
assertions: Passes its constructor to CommandDialog and supplies an ID with initialValues.
Binds InputTextField<RegisterAuthor> to the name property.

evals.name: open-dialog
evals.prompt: Let the reader open AddAuthor from the Authors screen more than once.
evals.expected_output: The caller uses useDialog and opens it on click.
assertions: Renders the returned dialog component once.
Opens it on button activation and restores focus to the trigger after close.

evals.name: submit-error
evals.prompt: Keep an invalid author name editable and avoid registering the same author twice after confirmation.
evals.expected_output: Keep submission and validation with the dialog.
assertions: Adds no second execute handler on close or on OK.
Keeps the form and server error summary visible.
Does not nest CommandForm inside CommandDialog.
